HESSA'S MENAGERIE [luxorZoo]

Welcome card: WATCH THE DEMO · LOOK AROUND · PUT ME TO WORK.

Walk mode: stick to move, 1 CALL, 2 TREAT, 3 JUMP, TALK to Hessa at her desk to start a shift.

Work: flick food from the tray into the bowl, hold HOSE and let go in the green, swipe mess, rub friendly animals, flick the TOY to wild ones. Swipe sideways for the next cage.

Open Main full window and turn the phone sideways to try landscape.
